title: Rehabilitation and re-entry
subtitle: Concepts, re-entry plans and a sociotherapy programme
readaptationIntro: You create a re-entry plan for someone leaving a facility or prison in their profile (“Re-entry” tab) – from a template covering housing, documents, work and education, health and addiction treatment, relationships and institutional support.
noPlansText: Open a person's profile and choose the “Re-entry” tab.
